name: Makdous
description: Baby aubergines stuffed with walnut and chilli, then kept submerged in olive oil for months.

tcm.note: Cured and oil-preserved with walnut and chilli.

ayurveda.note: Ushna; vrintaka is heating and the walnut adds to it.

histamine.note: Salt-cured, then months under oil — a preserved aubergine, which is two high things at once.
